instruction: Go to the page listing Atorvastatin's side effects.

metadata.explanation: Variation of the original Tamiflu task. User needs to search for Atorvastatin (a common cholesterol medication) and navigate to its side effects page. The task maintains the same complexity level as the original - single navigation to drugs.com side effects page. Uses custom metric is_expected_url_pattern_match_or__b070486d to check if the URL matches either of two valid side effects page patterns (with OR logic). Expected URLs follow the same pattern as the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree, which is the right state for verifying navigation tasks
Metric comparison logic is correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match_or__b070486d implements OR logic to check if URL matches ANY of the expected patterns using regex
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the URL against two valid Atorvastatin side effects page patterns (main page with #side-effects anchor and dedicated sfx page)
Expected values are correct: Both regex patterns match the actual valid Atorvastatin side effects URLs on drugs.com (with optional www subdomain)
Data flow is semantically correct: URL extraction -> regex pattern matching -> boolean result
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule': Uses 'rules' parameter name and accesses patterns via rules.get('expected', [])
Robust edge case handling: Handles empty/None results, both string and dict URL formats, and invalid regex patterns with proper error handling
